_comment: Explicit, reviewable migration choices for scripts/tenant-bootstrap.mjs. Nothing here is guessed from labels.
_legacyUserPartnerId: Every existing users/{uid} gets ONE membership in this Partner (decision: existing users → EV.ENGINEER).
_statusMap: Legacy users.status was never enforced (Pending users had full access), so Pending → Active preserves today's effective access. Change to "Pending" to force re-approval.
_confirmedPlatformAdminEmails: users.role was self-editable, so a legacy 'Platform Admin' role is NOT trusted. Only emails listed here (plus the hard-coded super admins) receive platformAdmins/{uid}. Unlisted legacy Platform Admins get the role below and are flagged in the report.
_flagElevatedLegacyRoles: These legacy roles are migrated as-is but listed in the report for manual confirmation, for the same reason.
